server.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_FORBIDDEN: Only an administrator can manage employment compensation.
server.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND: The employment record, employee or site is not available. Reload and check your selection.
server.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: Use the business currency for employment compensation.
server.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_OVERLAP: This employee already has employment terms in that period, possibly at another site. Review the dates.
server.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_STATE_INVALID: This change is not valid for the current employment record. Reload and review its dates and status.
server.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILA: Employment records are temporarily unavailable. Retry the same operation.
server.TIME_OFF_NOT_FOUND: The time-off request, employee or site is not available. Reload and check your selection.
server.TIME_OFF_WINDOW_INVALID: Choose valid absence dates, up to 366 days. The return date is not included.
server.TIME_OFF_OVERLAP: This employee has another pending or approved absence in that period, possibly at another site. Review the dates.
server.TIME_OFF_SCHEDULE_CONFLICT: Resolve this employee’s scheduled shifts in that period before approving the absence. No shifts were cancelled.
server.TIME_OFF_STATE_INVALID: This decision is not valid for the request’s current status. Reload and review its history.
server.TIME_OFF_SELF_APPROVAL: Another manager or administrator must approve your absence.
server.TIME_OFF_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: Time-off records are temporarily unavailable. Retry the same operation.
server.AVAILABILITY_NOT_FOUND: The availability policy or employee is not available. Reload and check your selection.
server.AVAILABILITY_OVERLAP: Another availability policy overlaps this period for this employee. Review all effective dates.
server.AVAILABILITY_STATE_INVALID: This availability policy is no longer configured. Reload and review its history.
server.AVAILABILITY_WINDOW_INVALID: Choose a valid effective period. A replacement must start strictly inside the previous policy’s dates.
server.AVAILABILITY_SCHEDULE_CONFLICT: Resolve existing shifts outside this availability before saving. No shifts were cancelled.
server.AVAILABILITY_SCHEDULE_CHANGED: Scheduled shifts changed during validation. Refresh and review the policy before retrying.
server.AVAILABILITY_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: Availability is temporarily unavailable. Retry the same operation.
server.SCHEDULE_DATE_RANGE_INVALID: Choose a valid schedule date range of up to 31 days.
server.SCHEDULE_WINDOW_INVALID: Choose a valid shift window of up to 24 hours.
server.SCHEDULE_EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND: This employee is not available for scheduling.
server.SCHEDULE_SITE_NOT_FOUND: Choose an active site for this shift.
server.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NOT_FOUND: This scheduled shift is no longer available.
server.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_OVERLAP: This employee already has a shift in that time window.
server.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_CANCELLED: A cancelled shift cannot be edited.
server.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_RECONCILED: This shift is frozen because its attendance was already reconciled.
server.SCHEDULE_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: Schedules are temporarily unavailable. Retry the same operation.
server.SCHEDULE_TIME_OFF_CONFLICT: This employee has approved time off in that interval, possibly at another site. Choose another employee or period.
server.SCHEDULE_AVAILABILITY_CONFLICT: This shift falls outside the employee’s configured availability, possibly at another site. Review the schedule and availability.
server.SCHEDULE_PLAN_NOT_FOUND: This schedule plan, employee or site is not available. Reload and check your selection.
server.SCHEDULE_PLAN_STATE_INVALID: Only a draft schedule can be changed, discarded or published. Reload and review its current status.
server.SCHEDULE_PLAN_CHANGED: The draft or scheduling policy changed during validation. Reload and review before publishing. This attempt did not create any shifts.
server.SCHEDULE_RECURRENCE_INVALID: Review the dates, weekdays and shift times. Use up to 31 starting dates, 100 rules and 1,000 shifts, without overlapping shifts for the same employee.
server.SHIFT_SWAP_NOT_FOUND: This exchange or shift is not available to you. Reload and check your selection.
server.SHIFT_SWAP_CHANGED: A shift changed or already started. Cancel the outdated request and create a new one if appropriate. No shifts were exchanged.
server.SHIFT_SWAP_STATE_INVALID: This action is not available. Reload the request. The other employee must accept before a manager or administrator who is not participating can approve.
server.SHIFT_SWAP_CLAIMED: One of these shifts already has an active exchange request. Resolve that request before creating another.
